Text alternative

Example histogram of x

The histogram covers 100 generated observations of x from 0 to 11. Each of the middle eight bins has 10 observations. The two bins at each end have 5 each.

x.svg

The 12 bins are each 11/12 of a unit wide. Each bin includes its lower boundary and excludes its upper boundary, except the last bin, which includes 11.
